The '''Stardogs''' were a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military veterans who came out of retirement to fight against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Jax Dumont]] was a member stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] who tasked a spacer with rescuing another Stardog who was investigating ties between the Sith Empire and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].
